component.name: Eternal Timer
component.summary: Timers and stopwatches that survive shutdowns and power cuts

description.p: Run any number of timers and stopwatches at once. Every item stores an absolute timestamp instead of a live countdown, so reopening the app after a reboot or a power cut shows exactly the right remaining or elapsed time. Nothing is lost.

ul.li: Animated liquid progress rings, a typed/scrolled HH:MM:SS picker and several color themes
Finish alarm sound and tray notifications
Per-timer history: every pause, and every gap caused by a power cut, shutdown or closed app
Optional end-to-end encrypted sync with the Android companion app, so a phone keeps counting and ringing even when the PC loses power

description.p: Sync is opt-in and uses a third-party relay (ntfy). The relay only sees encrypted data; see the project documentation for the limits of the free public relay.
Phone sync and Android app, liquid-ring redesign with themes, finish sound, per-timer history with power-cut detection.
Polished Qt redesign with animated circular progress rings and glass-panel styling.
